label: sparse conjunctive: sequences starting o/n with an early a (step after a), or first copy-phase input
explanation: Very sparse (0.03% of steps). Enriched in sequences whose first token is o or n (about 64% of mass), at the step right after an a in the original phase (prev_tok a, 11x lift), mostly at t=3-4, and at the recall_idx=1 copy step where orig(0) is fed back after <DEL> (35% of mass). Input o/v/t/c raise the rate, and it rarely fires when the sequence has digits. But every simple conjunction of these cues has precision under 20% and F1 at most 0.13. It looks like a specific mix of hidden-state contents (o, n, a, k, r, x, w early in the sequence) that boolean predicates do not capture. Never fires at t<2 or in the late copy phase (recall_idx>=3). Magnitude is fairly flat (median 0.12, max 0.23); the largest activations come from o/n-initial sequences with a at position 2-3.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=n (+4.64), orig1=n (+4.34), orig0=o (+4.27), prev_tok=<DEL> (+3.55), recall_idx=1 (+3.55), prev_tok=a (+3.53). Lower it: correct=1 (-5.73), phase=2 (-4.03), in_tok=n (-3.25), prev_tok=n (-2.88).
